```{r Read in OHI region boundaries}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) %>% 
  st_make_valid()

ohi_land   <- ohi_regions %>% dplyr::filter(location == "land")
ohi_marine <- ohi_regions %>% dplyr::filter(location == "marine")
```

# STEP 2: CALCULATE RHODOLITH "CURRENT EXTENT" less than 100m (source: Hem / CEDO rhodolith data [2025]) ------------------------------

```{r Read in rhodolith layer}

) %>%

CEDO_rhodolith.data_pts <- CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw %>%
```

## Remove all rhodolith beds < 100m

```{r Masks > than and ≤ than 100m}
# Geopatial mask for less than or equal to 100m depth:
mask_less_than_100m<- rast(
  here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/int/mask_depth_le_100m_1km.tif")
)

# Inspect mask
plot(mask_less_than_100m)
# Mask is a series of 0 and 1

# Shallow water: value 1
shallow_mask <- ifel(mask_less_than_100m == 1, 1, NA)

# Deep water: value 0
deep_mask <- ifel(mask_less_than_100m == 0, 1, NA)

# Convert the mask to polygons
shallow_poly <- as.polygons(
  shallow_mask,
  dissolve = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

deep_poly <- as.polygons(
  deep_mask,
  dissolve = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

plot(shallow_poly)
plot(deep_poly)
```

```{r Keep rhodolith beds within the <100 m mask}
pts <- terra::vect(CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw)

shallow_poly <- project(shallow_poly, crs(pts))
deep_poly <- project(deep_poly, crs(pts))

shallow_hit <- relate(
  pts, shallow_poly,
  relation = "intersects"
)

deep_hit <- relate(
  pts, deep_poly,
  relation = "intersects"
)

is_shallow <- apply(shallow_hit, 1, any)
is_deep <- apply(deep_hit, 1, any)

# FILTER:
colnames(CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw)

FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw %>%
  filter(is_shallow & !is_deep) %>%
  mutate(
    provenance = coalesce(
      na_if(trimws(REFEREN), ""),
      na_if(trimws(source), "")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    habitat, source = provenance, area_ha,
    lat = LATITUD, lon = LONGITU, geometry
  )
# 102 obs., 6 var.

plot(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)
```


```{r Check that lat long and area values align with polygon values we would expect}
# Check that the polygon CRS is defined
st_crs(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)

# Create point geometries from lon/lat
points_sf <- st_as_sf(
  FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area,
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = st_crs(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area),
  remove = FALSE
)

# Transform points into the polygon CRS
points_projected <- st_transform(
  points_sf,
  st_crs(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)
)

# Test whether each point falls inside its corresponding polygon
FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  mutate(
    point_inside = lengths(
      st_covered_by(
        points_projected,
        geometry,
        sparse = TRUE
      )
    ) > 0
  )

# Inspect the results
FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(habitat, lat, lon, point_inside)

table(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area$point_inside)
# 102 true. Looks good!

# Check polygon area versus reported area:

FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  mutate(
    polygon_area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 10000,
    area_difference_ha = polygon_area_ha - area_ha,
    percent_difference = 100 * area_difference_ha / area_ha
  ) %>%
  select(
    habitat, source, reported_area_ha = area_ha, polygon_area_ha,
    area_difference_ha, percent_difference,
    lat, lon, geometry
  )
# 102 obs.

```

```{r Assign RHOD extent to each OHI region}
# Assign each Rhodolith polygon to an OHI region (this will drop any land overlap, if applicable):
RHOD_Current_Extent0 <- st_intersection(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area, ohi_marine) %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  mutate(
    poly_id   = dplyr::row_number(),
    region_id = as.integer(id),
    area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 10000, 
    area_km2  = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6 # NOTE: st_area default unit is m2
  ) %>%
  filter(area_km2 > 0) %>%
  select(habitat, source, area_ha, area_km2, rgn_id, ecorgn, lat, lon, geometry)

RHOD_Current_Extent0

colnames(RHOD_Current_Extent0)

# Assign the rhodolith extent to each OHI region:
RHOD_Current_Extent <- RHOD_Current_Extent0 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_km2 = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    year = 2025
  )

all_rgns <- tibble(
  rgn_id = paste0("Region_", 1:9),
  year = 2025
)

RHOD_Current_Extent <- all_rgns %>%
  left_join(RHOD_Current_Extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = replace_na(area_km2, 0)) %>%
  select(rgn_id, 
         area_est_byCEDO.2025_km2 = area_km2, 
         year)

RHOD_Current_Extent
```

## Extract soft-bottom pressure under rhodolith beds
# NOTE TO SELF: THIS IS THE PART I'D LIKE A SECOND LOOK AT - Oct 13 2026

```{r Extract soft-bottom pressure underneath rhodolith beds}
# Restore original layer names
names(VMS_fishing_pressure_le100m) <- original_names

pressure_raster <- VMS_fishing_pressure_le100m
# Check CRS:
crs(pressure_raster)

# Convert rhodolith polygons to a SpatVector
rhodolith_vect <- terra::vect(RHOD_Current_Extent0)
# Check CRS:
crs(rhodolith_vect)

# Extract area-weighted mean fishing pressure value for each rhodolith polygon
# Note, some rhodolith polygons encompase multiple VMS raster cells, so we need to take the area-weighted mean:
pressure_values <- terra::extract(
  pressure_raster,
  rhodolith_vect,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  weights = TRUE, # This line assigning area weights is critical
  ID = TRUE
)

# Join extracted values back to the original polygon data
RHOD_Scores0 <- RHOD_Current_Extent0 %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(pressure_values, by = "ID") %>%
  select(-ID)

# Prop = average predicted probability of fishing disturbance per rhodolith bed x year.
# Example, if prop = 0.7, this means an average predicted disturbance probability of 70% across the extracted cells.
```


Pressure under each bed = area-weighted mean of `VMS_fishing_pressure` cells overlapping the polygon.
No recovery scaling applied for now (same 0–1 exposure scale as soft bottom).
```{r}

# Weighted mean pressure per rhodolith polygon × year
# Note, some rhodolith polygons encompase multiple VMS raster cells, so we need to take the mean:
ex <- terra::extract(
  pressure_raster,
  vect(RHOD_Scores0),
  fun = mean,
  weights = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  ID = TRUE
)

rhodolith_attributes <- st_drop_geometry(
  RHOD_Scores0
) %>%
  mutate(poly_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(poly_id, rgn_id, area_km2)

df_poly <- as_tibble(pressure_values) %>%
  rename(poly_id = ID) %>%
  left_join(
    rhodolith_attributes,
    by = "poly_id"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(pressure_cols),
    names_to = "layer",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(
      sub("prop_disturbed_", "", layer)
    )
  )

df_poly

# Prop = average predicted probability of fishing disturbance per rhodolith bed x year.
# Example, if prop = 0.7, this means an average predicted disturbance probability of 70% across the extracted cells.
```

```{r}
 RHOD_Scores0<- RHOD_Scores0 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(pressure_cols),
    names_to = "layer",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(
      sub("prop_disturbed_", "", layer)
    )
  )

# Area-weighted average pressure per region × year
RHOD_Scores <- RHOD_Scores0 %>%
  filter(!is.na(prop), !is.na(rgn_id), area_km2 > 0) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(rgn_id, year) %>%
  summarise(
    area_sum  = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Must be in this order:
    Pressure  = sum(prop * area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / area_sum,
    RHOD_current_status = 1 - Pressure,
    Pressure  = Pressure * 100,
    RHOD_current_status = RHOD_current_status * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

RHOD_Scores

```

```{r Join rgn_name to scores}

colnames(RHOD_Scores)

RHOD_Scores <- RHOD_Scores %>%
  left_join(Region_Key, by = "rgn_id")
  
RHOD_Scores<- RHOD_Scores %>%
  relocate(rgn_name, .before = rgn_id)
```

# STEP 5: ESTIMATE RHOD TREND (source: multiple data sources, 2007-present) ------------------------------

```{r}
# Trend Calculation: lm for most recent 5 years of data
year_end <- max(RHOD_Scores$year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_start <- year_end - 4
# NOTE TO SELF: This might also change.

calc_trends <- function(d) {
  ys <- min(d$year)
  ye <- max(d$year)
  cs <- d$RHOD_current_status[d$year == ys][1]
  fit_lin <- lm(RHOD_current_status ~ year, data = d)
  fit_log <- lm(log(pmax(RHOD_current_status, 1e-6)) ~ year, data = d)
  slope_lin <- unname(coef(fit_lin)["year"])
  slope_log <- unname(coef(fit_log)["year"])
  tibble(
    year = ye,
    year_start = ys,
    year_end = ye,
    condition_start = cs,
    trend_pct_linear = (slope_lin / cs) * 100,
    trend_pct_cagr   = (exp(slope_log) - 1) * 100
  )
}
RHOD_Trend <- RHOD_Scores %>%
  filter(year >= year_start, year <= year_end) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ calc_trends(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

RHOD_Trend
```


## METHOD B

```{r Calculate RHOD_Trend using METHOD B}
# METHOD B: 
# See GitHub issue, Oct 7 2026, for more details: https://github.com/OHI-GOC/OHI_GOC_issues/issues/127#issuecomment-6041025924
# slope = fit a linear model: lm(area ~ year), grab the slope estimate
# trend_pct_year <- (1 + slope/earliest_area_in_lm)

# Pull the most recent year and the comparison year:
most_recent_year = max(RHOD_Scores$year, na.rm = TRUE)

comparison_year <- min(
  RHOD_Scores$year[
    RHOD_Scores$year < most_recent_year &
    RHOD_Scores$year >= most_recent_year - 10 &
    RHOD_Scores$year <= most_recent_year - 5
  ],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

RHOD_score_lm <- RHOD_Scores %>%
  filter(
    year >= comparison_year,
    year <= most_recent_year
  ) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(
      lm(RHOD_current_status ~ year, data = pick(everything()))
    ),
    comparison_status = RHOD_current_status[year == comparison_year][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    slope = sapply(model, function(x) coef(x)[["year"]]),
    p_value = sapply(
      model,
      function(x) summary(x)$coefficients["year", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    ),
    trend_pct_year = round((slope / comparison_status) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(rgn_id, 
         trend_linear_pct_year_opB = trend_pct_year,
         lm_slope= slope, 
         p_value)

```


```{r Make a nice Ktable for RHOD_score_lm}
colnames(RHOD_score_lm)

RHOD_score_lm %>%
  select(rgn_id, trend_linear_pct_year_opB, p_value) %>%
  kable(digits = 4, col.names = c("Region", "Trend (method B)", "p_value")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered")) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c('Rhodolith Bed Trend' = 3))
```

```{r Save RHOD_Trend}
RHOD_Trend<- RHOD_score_lm

write.csv(RHOD_Trend,
          here::here("_habitats/HAB_rhodolith_beds/RHO_outputs/RHOD_Trend_Oct132026.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

```
